ADVANCED SMARTLINK.rules: For the modified Smartgun Link or Smart Rebuild: a Critical Failure on the attack no longer rolls the implosion d10; its other effects still happen.

CHIPWARE LINK.rules: For the modified Smartgun Link or Smart Rebuild: adds one Chipware Socket for Memory Chips and Skill Chips. While linked to the weapon, you get the chip's benefits without Humanity Loss or using your own chipware slots.

CRITOCHET.rules: For the modified Power Rebuild: when a Ricochet attack causes a randomly rolled Critical Injury (not a Leg Aimed Shot), roll twice and pick one.

CUSTOM-FITTED MAGRAILS.rules: For a Magrail Kit on an Exotic Ranged Weapon only: the kit's slots are no longer limited to single-slot attachments.

C-THRU.rules: For the modified Tech Rebuild: while charged it can also fire through Thick Cover. It doesn't grant sight through that cover, so you need another way to see the target.

GAMBITEER.rules: For the modified Smart Rebuild: Improved Smart ammo rerolls attacks at +10 instead of +14, but also counts as Armor-Piercing (ablates 2 SP).

LOW LATENCY.rules: For the modified Smartgun Link or Smart Rebuild: it loses its +1 to attacks. Instead, drawing or wielding the weapon in the first Round of combat raises your current Initiative by 2 while you keep actively using it; stowing it or having it knocked away removes the bonus.

MINI-MAG.rules: For the modified Extended Magazine: it no longer makes the weapon unconcealable.

MULTI-AMMO SELECTOR.rules: For a Belt Box or Drum Magazine, or a Pistol that can't take Capacity attachments: the magazine holds up to 3 compatible ammo types at once; choose per shot. Stacks with magazines that already hold several types. Modes that fire several rounds must use rounds of one type for its effects to apply.

PANORAMA.rules: For the modified Smart Rebuild: it loses its +1 to attacks. Instead, Improved Smart ammo rerolls attacks that miss by 7 or less instead of 5 or less.

PYRO.rules: For the modified Power Rebuild: it no longer adds +5 Critical Injury Bonus Damage. Instead, randomly rolled Critical Injuries (not Leg Aimed Shots) also set the target Mildly on Fire, or raise the fire's tier by one if the attack already sets fires (Mild to Strong to Deadly).

SOLENOID MECHANISM.rules: For the modified Smartgun Link or Smart Rebuild: Aimed Shots, or non-Aimed attacks with Take Extra Time, from a Non-Explosive weapon at targets beyond 200m/yds count as High Precision ammo if you meet High Precision's usual requirements. Doesn't stack with real High Precision ammo. Can't be combined with a Binary Trigger or Match Trigger.

SPINETICKLER.rules: For the modified Tech Rebuild: when a charged shot causes a randomly rolled Critical Injury (not a Leg Aimed Shot), the target skips the Bonus Damage (the injury still applies) and suffers EMP Ammunition's effect instead; the attack's normal damage still applies. If the attack already causes that effect, the target takes -4 on the Cybertech check.

SWISS CHEESE.rules: For the modified Power Rebuild: it no longer adds +5 Critical Injury Bonus Damage. Instead, an attack that ablates armor and causes a randomly rolled Critical Injury (not a Leg Aimed Shot) ablates 1 extra SP; this stacks with other ablation bonuses.

TWIN-LINKED.rules: For Smartgun Links and Smart Rebuilds: while wielding two or more Twin-Linked weapons, fire them all at one target as a Linked Attack, all in the same fire mode and all Explosive or all Non-Explosive. Use the highest DV among them and your lowest Skill among them; each weapon spends its usual ammo. On a hit, roll the biggest damage source and add +1 per d6 the other weapons would have rolled (for Autofire, the biggest source is the highest Autofire rating). Example: a 3d6 pistol linked with a 5d6 rifle at 12m/yds uses the rifle's DV16 and deals 5d6+3.

AIRSTRIKE.rules: In combat, after you jump more than 6m/yds, the weapon's next attack before your next Turn deals +1d6. If that attack causes a Critical Injury, the target must pass a DV13 Athletics check or be knocked Prone.

split: Bladesmith (Barbed)
Barbed: every attack also has the effect of Burrowing Ammunition (Interface RED Vol. 5).
Bladesmith (Guided)
Guided: every attack also has the effect of Smart Ammunition.
Bladesmith (Serrated)
Serrated: every attack also has the effect of Hollow Point Ammunition (Interface RED Vol. 5).
Bladesmith (Sharpened)
Sharpened: the first time the weapon ablates armor each Round, it ablates 1 extra SP.
Bladesmith (Volatile)
Volatile: every attack also has the effect of Incendiary Ammunition.
BLADESMITH.rules: A melee weapon mod; choose one version.

BLEEDOUT.rules: The weapon's Critical Injuries deal +5 Bonus Damage.

BOOMERANG.rules: For throwable melee weapons: if you have an active Targeting Scope, a thrown weapon returns to you at the start of your next Turn, wherever you are.

COVERT BUILD.rules: Security scanners can't detect the weapon. Non-Explosive Ranged Weapons other than bows and crossbows also get a built-in Improved Silencer that uses no slot.

CYCLONE.rules: For ROF 2 melee weapons: if you've moved more than 8m/yds since the start of your last Turn and have now damaged the same target twice this Turn, that target immediately takes 3 damage straight to HP.

DEFLECTION.rules: Once per Round at the start of your Turn you can enter Blocking Stance without an Action, if you have active Speedware, Berserk, or Timewarp's primary effect; have no REF, DEX, or MOVE penalty; and aren't Prone, grappled, or in a vehicle. Until your next Turn you hold the weapon two-handed, can't make Aimed Shots, take -2 REF, DEX, and MOVE, and have a Bulletproof Shield of 5 HP (Poor), 10 HP (Standard), or 15 HP (Excellent, or with a total Initiative bonus of +4 or more); its HP refills each time you enter the stance. If it's destroyed, you leave the stance and the weapon drops one quality tier (Poor becomes non-functional); restoring it takes 10 minutes and a DV13 Weaponstech check.

notes: For melee weapons, bows, and crossbows: with active Speedware, spending at least 1 LUCK on a non-thrown attack gives an extra +1 on top of the LUCK (situational).

EQUALIZER.rules: For Non-Explosive Ranged Weapons: if an attack's damage doesn't beat the target's SP, roll 1d6 and add it before armor; if that now beats the SP, the attack damages and ablates normally. The extra d6 doesn't count toward Critical Injuries.

FASHIONISTA.rules: The weapon can hold one Fashionware or Cyberlimb Coating option (not Shift Tacts, Chemskin, Techhair, or Hardened Shielding), bought separately. Its bonus only works while the weapon is carried or worn openly.

GLOW SIGHTS.rules: Doesn't stack with a Short Scope.
notes: For bows, crossbows, pistols, SMGs, and shotguns without a Smart Rebuild: +1 to Single Shot attacks at 0-12m/yds while held two-handed (situational); One-Handed weapons don't become Two-Handed.

HAEMOCIDE.rules: For melee weapons: every attack has Explosive Ammunition's effect, including its -2 to hit and no Aimed Shots.

INTEGRATED SMARTLINK.rules: For ranged weapons without a Smart Rebuild or Smartgun Link: adds a Smartgun Link that uses no slot and counts as its own attachment for Tech Upgrades and other mods. No second Smartgun Link can be added, and the weapon won't fire unless you're linked to it by an Interface Plug or Subdermal Grip.

JAVELIN.rules: For throwable Light and Medium melee weapons: when thrown, it halves the target's SP and can be thrown as half of a ROF 2 attack.

K.O..name: K.O.
K.O..rules: For melee weapons: damage to the Head forces a DV13 Athletics check to avoid being knocked Prone. A target already Prone instead makes a DV13 Endurance check or falls Unconscious for 30 seconds (10 Rounds), until damaged or woken by someone adjacent as an Action. All of the weapon's BODY requirements rise by 1.

KINETIC ABSORPTION.rules: For weapons with any BODY requirement: every BODY requirement drops by 3 (minimum 1). Tech Upgrades can't lower them further.

KINETIC RECYCLER.rules: For ROF 1 ranged weapons dealing under 5d6: the weapon becomes Exotic and its Capacity is halved (rounded up, after other attachments and mods). If it fired last Round, it's ROF 2 this Round.

KNEEL!.name: Kneel!
KNEEL!.rules: For shotguns: an Aimed Shot to a Leg that causes Broken Leg deals +5 Bonus Damage (stacking with other sources). If that leg is already broken, it's Dismembered instead.

MENACING.rules: +1 Complementary Bonus to Facedown or Interrogation checks when you threaten violence with this weapon. Doesn't stack with the same bonus from another weapon.

MODULAR RAILS.rules: The weapon can no longer go in cyberware or cyberware-like gear such as Battlegloves, but can still be vehicle-mounted. Tech Upgrades can't add more slots through this mod.
notes: For ranged weapons: adds 2 Attachment Slots (automated).

OPPRESSOR.rules: For weapons with Suppressive Fire: everyone resisting its Suppressive Fire takes -2 on the Concentration check. The weapon can never be silenced or suppressed.

PAX.rules: For Non-Explosive Ranged Weapons with a Smartgun Link or Smart Rebuild: while linked, you can make an attack's rounds count as Rubber ammo. This drains its single-use battery, which recharges in 1 hour or is replaced as an Action (spares 50eb, Costly).

RACE BUILD.rules: If the weapon is already drawn in the first Round of combat, your current Initiative rises by 2 while you keep actively using it. On an Excellent Quality weapon the Initiative bonus is 3 instead, but the weapon loses Excellent Quality's +1 to hit. Stowing it or having it knocked away removes the bonus. Popup weapons count as wielded only while popped up.

RAPID FIRE.rules: A weapon that was already ROF 2 can now make Aimed Shots and use alternate fire modes at ROF 2.
notes: For Non-Explosive weapons: ROF becomes 2 (automated as an override).
All attacks take -2 (automated), and every BODY requirement rises by 3.

For assault rifles and sniper rifles without Autofire: if you fired it last Round, you can give up your Move Action at the start of your Turn for +1 to all attacks with it until your next Turn (situational).

RELIABLE.rules: For weapons that can jam: using a jammed weapon has a 50% chance to work normally, which also clears the jam. If you lose the coin flip, the Action is wasted but the jam still clears.

REWEIGHTED.rules: For Two-Handed weapons: it can now be wielded One-Handed, but it can't be concealed, used as a Popup Weapon, or mounted in a Vehicle Heavy Weapon Mount. Tech Upgrades can't remove these drawbacks.

SHUFFLER.rules: For weapons that can reload by giving up a Move Action: that reload now costs only half your MOVE, paid before you move that Turn. Reloading the normal way takes 1 extra Action.

SLICE ‘EM UP.name: Slice 'Em Up
SLICE ‘EM UP.rules: For bladed melee weapons: when it causes a Critical Injury, roll twice and pick one.

SOLVENT.rules: For Excellent Quality Non-Explosive Ranged Weapons only: every hit also splashes the target with an Acid Paintball, which marks them in your chosen color and lowers the SP of the armor at that location by 1 even if the attack didn't get through.

STERILE SURFACE.rules: For Light melee weapons: as an Action, coat it with a Street Drug (Medtechs may also use Pharmaceuticals). It lasts 30 minutes or until the next attack; if that attack damages past armor, the drug applies as if by Airhypo. A miss doesn't use it up.

SUPERIOR AUTOSEAR.rules: For weapons whose Autofire uses 20+ rounds: Autofire uses 10 rounds, or half its old amount (rounded up) if that was more than 20.

UPSIZED POWER.price_note: Costs the base weapon's cost (minimum 1,000eb); the listed price is the minimum.
UPSIZED POWER.rules: The weapon can't be concealed, silenced, or suppressed, and Tech Upgrades can't remove these drawbacks. Existing BODY requirements rise by half (rounded up) the number of damage dice it now rolls on a non-Aimed Single Shot. A weapon with no BODY minimum to wield gains one: that dice count x2, +2 if One-Handed or a bow, +1 if ROF 2+, +2 if Autofire-only or already Autofire 5+. Being mounted also satisfies it. A One-Handed weapon may be made Two-Handed when this is installed. Example: a 3d6, ROF 2, one-handed Heavy Pistol becomes 4d6 and needs BODY 11 (4x2 + 2 + 1), or BODY 9 if made Two-Handed. Autofire-only weapons use their base type's dice for this (Assault Rifle for machine guns) but still can't fire Single Shot.
notes: For Non-Explosive weapons that deal damage: +1d6 damage and +1 Autofire rating, including alternate modes such as shotgun shells (edit the weapon's damage and Autofire by hand).

split: Conversion Kit: Assault (Sniper Rifles)
Assault Kit (Sniper Rifles): Scout Rifle becomes Battle Rifle, Sniper Rifle becomes Assault Rifle, Anti-Materiel Rifle becomes Marksman Rifle.
Conversion Kit: DMR (Very Heavy Pistols, Assault Rifles)

DMR Kit (Very Heavy Pistols and Assault Rifles): fires with Shoulder Arms. Pistol (any) or Carbine becomes Scout Rifle, Assault Rifle or Battle Rifle becomes Sniper Rifle, Marksman Rifle becomes Anti-Materiel Rifle.
Conversion Kit: Carbine (Very Heavy Pistols, SMGs)
Carbine Kit (Very Heavy Pistols and all SMGs): Pistol (any) or Subcompact SMG becomes Carbine, SMG becomes Assault Rifle.
Conversion Kit: Payload (Grenade/Rocket Launchers)

Payload Kit (Grenade and Rocket Launchers): deals 1d6 less, and explosives burst in only a 6x6m/yds (3x3 square) area. It can take a Silencer, which muffles the launch but not the blast. Grenade Launcher becomes Scout Rifle, Rocket Launcher becomes Sniper Rifle, Missile Launcher becomes Anti-Materiel Rifle.
Conversion Kit: PDW (Pistols)
PDW Kit (all Pistols): Snubnose Pistol becomes Subcompact SMG, Pistol becomes SMG, Long Barrel Pistol becomes Carbine.
Conversion Kit: Ramjet (Bows/Crossbows)
Ramjet Kit (Bows and Crossbows): Shortbow becomes Long Barrel Shotgun, Bow becomes Assault Rifle, Longbow becomes Scout Rifle.
Conversion Kit: Rifle (Very Heavy Pistols, SMGs)
Rifle Kit (Very Heavy Pistols and all SMGs): fires with Shoulder Arms. Snubnose Pistol, Pistol, or Subcompact SMG becomes Assault Rifle; Long Barrel Pistol or SMG becomes Battle Rifle.
Conversion Kit: SBR (Assault/Sniper Rifles)

SBR Kit (Assault and Sniper Rifles): Single Shot deals 1d6 less (minimum 4d6) and Autofire rating drops by 1 (minimum 3). Carbine becomes Snubnose Pistol, Assault Rifle becomes Subcompact SMG, Battle Rifle becomes SMG, Marksman or Scout Rifle becomes Long Barrel Pistol, Sniper or Anti-Materiel Rifle becomes Carbine.
WEAPON CONVERSION KITS.rules: Changes the weapon's range table as listed (change the weapon's DV table field to match). The weapon can take attachments for its new category if it otherwise qualifies, and becomes Two-Handed and unconcealable. Damage, Autofire rating, Capacity, and Capacity Chart row don't change unless the kit says so. While installed, Range Table Modifications can't be added, removed, or swapped.

ZERO-G.rules: For throwable Light, Medium, and Heavy melee weapons: can be thrown up to 50m/yds, or 100m/yds with BODY 12.

MOD NEXUS.rules: Invented Tech Upgrade for a weapon: it can hold a second Weapon Mod (2 total unless it has a preinstalled one). No duplicate mods.

REBUILD REDUCTION.rules: Invented Tech Upgrade for a Rebuild attachment: it needs 1 fewer slot (1 for Tech or Smart, 0 for Power) but can never be removed from its weapon.
notes: Adjust the Rebuild's slot size by hand.

SAWN OFF.rules: Invented Tech Upgrade for a Non-Concealable, Non-Explosive Two-Handed Ranged Weapon other than a bow: it becomes concealable, but attacks take -2 (-4 beyond 50m/yds) and every BODY requirement rises by 3. It overrides mods that prevent concealment (such as Conversion Kits or Upsized Power), but not attachments that do (such as an Extended Magazine or Foregrip).

STEADIED SCOPE.rules: Invented Tech Upgrade for a scope that gives a Single Shot bonus: that bonus now also applies to Autofire attacks that meet the scope's usual conditions (for example, a Sniping Scope beyond 50m/yds).

WEAPON TUNING.rules: Invented Tech Upgrade for a damaging Ranged Weapon; can't be removed. When installing, pick A or B for each: Accuracy (A: -3 damage, or B: -1 to hit); Ergonomics (A: +1 Attachment Slot, or B: +1 to hit); Power (A: +3 damage, or B: +1 SP ablation); Weight (A: +1 Action to reload, or B: -1 REF, DEX, and MOVE while wielded).
notes: Apply the chosen values to the weapon or this item by hand.
